title: There and Back
subtitle: 城市生活 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 城市生活（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·城市生活）
meta: 主题语境：城市生活（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·城市生活）　|　核心词汇：there　|　正文 309 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 there 的位置与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: ① There, in 1978 the grandmother put the lamp at the window, and everybody in the courtyard said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three years on, people still spoke of that morning: the grandmother had put the lamp ② there without a word of thanks, and nobody had asked a single question. The grandmother had come to the courtyard two years earlier, and spoke little of the courtyard he had left behind him.

The diary for February 1972 puts it plainer. The lamp was ③ there, and the child who kept it wrote of the lamp ④ there in the same line; nothing in the courtyard was ever left there for long in those days. The child wrote that line himself and read it aloud once every year thereafter.

My uncle, who kept the lamp at the far window, meant something else. He had come from ⑤ there, and ⑥ There came the child who was to carry it back; he was not a man who explained himself, and the courtyard had long since stopped asking him to.

By 1985 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the diary. What the line asked for was that the lamp be kept ⑦ there at the window, and that everybody be ⑧ there before the February rains. Everybody laughed at the wording, and then did exactly what it said, as they always did; everybody there knew the work had been carried there.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1988 she put the lamp ⑨ there at once when nobody else would, and ⑩ There, she said in 1990, that was the part the courtyard never forgot; the diary still speaks of it there. She kept the lamp in the same window for thirty years afterwards, and never once said why; the courtyard never forgot how there it had all been done.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adv. 在那里（句末状语，置于宾语之后：put the lamp there，文中第 2、9 题两处）
B. adv. 在那里（作表语，说明处所或去向：the lamp was there）
C. adv. 往那里（置于句首：There, …，文中第 1、10 题两处）
D. adv. 往那里（作后置定语，紧跟被修饰的名词：the lamp there）
E. adv. 往那里（作介词宾语：from there）
F. adv. 往那里（句首强调，引起全部倒装：There came the child）
G. adv. 在那里（被动结构中置于过去分词之后：be kept there at the window）
H. adv. 在那里（be there 说明所在或去向：everybody be there before the rains）

answers.why: there 意为“往那里”，此处置于句首交代地点或去向：There, in 1978 …。
there 意为“在那里”，此处置于宾语之后作状语：had put the lamp there。
there 意为“在那里”，此处作表语说明那件小小的灯的去向或所在：was there。
there 意为“往那里”，此处作后置定语紧跟名词：the lamp there。
there 意为“往那里”，此处作介词 from 的宾语：from there。
there 意为“往那里”，此处置于句首引起全部倒装：There came the child。
there 意为“在那里”，被动结构中副词置于过去分词之后：be kept there at the window。
there 意为“在那里”，be there 说明众人须在雨季前到达某处或处于某状态。
there 意为“在那里”，1988 年母亲在无人肯做时又一次放置那件小小的灯，副词置于句末。
there 意为“往那里”，母亲 1990 年那句话以地点状语开头：There, …。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1978 年，祖母在窗边放置那件小小的灯；院子里人人都说那是头一回。（There, …）
祖母已经把那件小小的灯放置在那里。（… there …）
那件小小的灯当时就在在那里。（was there）
日记那一行写的是在那里的那件小小的灯。（the lamp there）
叔叔是从在那里回来的。（from there）
记录要求那件小小的灯在窗边被守着在那里。（be kept there）
answers: There, in 1978 the grandmother put the lamp at the window.
The grandmother had put the lamp there without a word of thanks.
